title: Joining the project in 1978; by 1979 no defense against remote viewing
summary: Joe McMoneagle tells of Joining the project in 1978; by 1979 no defense against remote viewing, about 1978-1990s at United States (no place named), and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: I got brought into the project in October of 78 by July of 79 we knew there was no defense against remote fuing

plain: Joe McMoneagle, a man who says he worked as a remote viewer, says he was brought into a US government project in October 1978, linked to Fort Meade in Maryland. Remote viewing is the claimed ability to describe distant places or things using only the mind. He says that by July 1979 the project knew there was no defense against it, which would mean no secret anywhere could be fully hidden.
